<h1 id="starlette---轻量级asgi-web框架">starlette - 轻量级ASGI Web框架</h1>
<h2 id="一什么是starlette">一、什么是starlette？</h2>
<p><strong>starlette</strong> 是一个轻量级、高性能的ASGI框架，用于构建异步Web服务。<br>
它可以帮助你：</p>
<ul>
<li>快速创建API和Web应用</li>
<li>处理异步请求和响应</li>
<li>提供WebSocket支持</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="二应用场景">二、应用场景</h2>
<p><strong>starlette</strong> 广泛应用于以下实际场景：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>构建RESTful API</strong>: 创建高性能的后端服务。</li>
<li><strong>开发实时Web应用</strong>: 利用WebSocket实现双向通信。</li>
<li><strong>微服务架构</strong>: 作为轻量级服务的基础框架。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="三如何安装">三、如何安装</h2>
<ol>
<li>使用 pip 安装</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-bash">pip install starlette uvicorn

# 如果安装慢的话，推荐使用国内镜像源
pip install starlette uvicorn -i https://www.python64.cn/pypi/simple/
</code></pre>
<ol start="2">
<li>使用 <a href="https://www.min2k.com/tools/python-run/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">PythonRun</a> 在线运行代码（无需本地安装）</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="四示例代码">四、示例代码</h2>
<p>创建一个简单的Starlette Web应用，该应用根据查询参数返回不同的问候语。</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">from starlette.applications import Starlette
from starlette.responses import PlainTextResponse
from starlette.routing import Route
import uvicorn

async def homepage(request):
    name = request.query_params.get('name') # 获取查询参数'name'
    if name: # 如果'name'存在
        message = f"Hello, {name}!"
    else: # 如果'name'不存在
        message = "Hello, World!"
    return PlainTextResponse(message)

routes = [
    Route("/", endpoint=homepage)
]

app = Starlette(routes=routes)

# 注意：在实际部署中，你会使用uvicorn命令行来运行。
# 这里是为了让代码在PythonRun中直接运行而包含。
# 在本地运行此文件后，访问 http://127.0.0.1:8000/ 或 http://127.0.0.1:8000/?name=Alice
if __name__ == "__main__":
    # PythonRun无法直接运行Web服务器，但可以在本地环境运行
    # uvicorn app:app --reload
    # print("Run 'uvicorn app:app --reload' in your terminal and visit http://127.0.0.1:8000/")
    
    # 为了在PythonRun中模拟输出，这里不启动服务器
    # 以下代码不会在PythonRun中实际运行服务器，仅作演示
    print("This Starlette application would normally run with a server like Uvicorn.")
    print("To test, manually construct URLs:")
    print("Visit / to see 'Hello, World!'")
    print("Visit /?name=Alice to see 'Hello, Alice!'")
</code></pre>
<p>使用 <a href="https://www.min2k.com/tools/python-run/?code=from%20starlette.applications%20import%20Starlette%0Afrom%20starlette.responses%20import%20PlainTextResponse%0Afrom%20starlette.routing%20import%20Route%0Aimport%20uvicorn%0A%0Aasync%20def%20homepage%28request%29%3A%0A%20%20%20%20name%20%3D%20request.query_params.get%28'name'%29%20%23%20%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96%E6%9F%A5%E8%AF%A2%E5%8F%82%E6%95%B0'name'%0A%20%20%20%20if%20name%3A%20%23%20%E5%A6%82%E6%9E%9C'name'%E5%AD%98%E5%9C%A8%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20message%20%3D%20f%22Hello%2C%20%7Bname%7D!%22%0A%20%20%20%20else%3A%20%23%20%E5%A6%82%E6%9E%9C'name'%E4%B8%8D%E5%AD%98%E5%9C%A8%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20message%20%3D%20%22Hello%2C%20World!%22%0A%20%20%20%20return%20PlainTextResponse%28message%29%0A%0Aroutes%20%3D%20%5B%0A%20%20%20%20Route%28%22%2F%22%2C%20endpoint%3Dhomepage%29%0A%5D%0A%0Aapp%20%3D%20Starlette%28routes%3Droutes%29%0A%0A%23%20%E6%B3%A8%E6%84%8F%EF%BC%9A%E5%9C%A8%E5%AE%9E%E9%99%85%E9%83%A8%E7%BD%B2%E4%B8%AD%EF%BC%8C%E4%BD%A0%E4%BC%9A%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8uvicorn%E5%91%BD%E4%BB%A4%E8%A1%8C%E6%9D%A5%E8%BF%90%E8%A1%8C%E3%80%82%0A%23%20%E8%BF%99%E9%87%8C%E6%98%AF%E4%B8%BA%E4%BA%86%E8%AE%A9%E4%BB%A3%E7%A0%81%E5%9C%A8PythonRun%E4%B8%AD%E7%9B%B4%E6%8E%A5%E8%BF%90%E8%A1%8C%E8%80%8C%E5%8C%85%E5%90%AB%E3%80%82%0A%23%20%E5%9C%A8%E6%9C%AC%E5%9C%B0%E8%BF%90%E8%A1%8C%E6%AD%A4%E6%96%87%E4%BB%B6%E5%90%8E%EF%BC%8C%E8%AE%BF%E9%97%AE%20http%3A%2F%2F127.0.0.1%3A8000%2F%20%E6%88%96%20http%3A%2F%2F127.0.0.1%3A8000%2F%3Fname%3DAlice%0Aif%20__name__%20%3D%3D%20%22__main__%22%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20PythonRun%E6%97%A0%E6%B3%95%E7%9B%B4%E6%8E%A5%E8%BF%90%E8%A1%8CWeb%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E5%99%A8%EF%BC%8C%E4%BD%86%E5%8F%AF%E4%BB%A5%E5%9C%A8%E6%9C%AC%E5%9C%B0%E7%8E%AF%E5%A2%83%E8%BF%90%E8%A1%8C%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20uvicorn%20app%3Aapp%20--reload%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20print%28%22Run%20'uvicorn%20app%3Aapp%20--reload'%20in%20your%20terminal%20and%20visit%20http%3A%2F%2F127.0.0.1%3A8000%2F%22%29%0A%20%20%20%20%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20%E4%B8%BA%E4%BA%86%E5%9C%A8PythonRun%E4%B8%AD%E6%A8%A1%E6%8B%9F%E8%BE%93%E5%87%BA%EF%BC%8C%E8%BF%99%E9%87%8C%E4%B8%8D%E5%90%AF%E5%8A%A8%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E5%99%A8%0A%20%20%20%20%23%20%E4%BB%A5%E4%B8%8B%E4%BB%A3%E7%A0%81%E4%B8%8D%E4%BC%9A%E5%9C%A8PythonRun%E4%B8%AD%E5%AE%9E%E9%99%85%E8%BF%90%E8%A1%8C%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E5%99%A8%EF%BC%8C%E4%BB%85%E4%BD%9C%E6%BC%94%E7%A4%BA%0A%20%20%20%20print%28%22This%20Starlette%20application%20would%20normally%20run%20with%20a%20server%20like%20Uvicorn.%22%29%0A%20%20%20%20print%28%22To%20test%2C%20manually%20construct%20URLs%3A%22%29%0A%20%20%20%20print%28%22Visit%20%2F%20to%20see%20'Hello%2C%20World!'%22%29%0A%20%20%20%20print%28%22Visit%20%2F%3Fname%3DAlice%20to%20see%20'Hello%2C%20Alice!'%22%29" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">PythonRun</a> 在线运行这段代码，结果如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-text">This Starlette application would normally run with a server like Uvicorn.
To test, manually construct URLs:
Visit / to see 'Hello, World!'

</code></pre>
